name: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
overview: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: In routine practice, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a long-term lung condition that makes it progressively harder to breathe.
In routine practice, it occurs when the airways and lung tissue become damaged, leading to reduced airflow and reduced efficiency of oxygen exchange in the lungs.

faq.question: What should I do if Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease symptoms worsen suddenly?
